description: This file defines the utility class 'ExpressionUiHelper' which provides helper methods for generating UI artifacts related to temporal expressions, such as lists of weekdays, months, frequencies, expression types, and candidate temporal expression IDs for inclusion. It encapsulates logic for locale-specific date handling and references various external entity and utility classes.

classes.name: ExpressionUiHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to generate lists of date and time-related UI options, as well as methods to fetch candidate temporal expressions for inclusion, supporting locale-specific formats and business logic.

methods.name: getOccurrenceList
methods.description: Returns a list of valid DayInMonth occurrence values, including positive, negative, and special cases.

methods.name: getDayValueList
methods.description: Generates a list of maps each containing a localized day name (description) and its corresponding numeric value, for all days of the week according to the specified locale.

methods.name: getFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week for the given locale.

methods.name: getLastDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the last day of the week for the given locale.

methods.name: getMonthValueList
methods.description: Generates a list of maps each containing a month name (description) and its numeric value, localized to the given locale.

methods.name: getFrequencyValueList
methods.description: Provides a list of frequency options (second, minute, hour, day, month, year) each with a description and value, based on provided UI labels.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Creates a list of temporal expression types with their descriptions derived from UI labels.

methods.name: getCandidateIncludeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a set of candidate temporal expression IDs for inclusion, filtering out those already linked or identical, based on delegator queries.
